paragraphs.text: Euru is a legendary squirrelfolk soldier from Bloomburrow .

Euru is a red squirrelfolk with a large bushy tail, clad in a patchwork of earthy, tattered garments that blend into the forest surroundings. He can be seen crouched low on a tree stump, his sharp eyes focused on a small pile of large acorns before him. Euru can conjure a swirling, ethereal purple energy, suggesting that he possesses some magical ability to aid in his scavenging. The forest around him is dense and eerie, with greenish light filtering through the trees, a darker part of the otherwise bright lands of Bloomburrow .
